question: In which stadium was the inaugural ceremony of the 19th Commonwealth Games held in 2010?
solution: The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The inaugural ceremony of the **19th Commonwealth Games** held in **2010** was hosted at the **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** in **New Delhi, India**. • The stadium is one of the largest in the country and was specifically refurbished for the Commonwealth Games with state-of-the-art facilities. • The inaugural event featured a grand display of **Indian culture, music, and dance performances**, showcasing the nation's rich heritage. • The ceremony included a spectacular **‘Aerostat’ balloon**, a first-of-its-kind in India, which was used to project visuals and enhance the viewing experience for the audience. • The **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** served as the centerpiece for the Commonwealth Games, hosting the opening and closing ceremonies as well as several athletic events.
